title: Zuckerberg’s $300m superyacht docks in Japan, gets neighbour who once wanted Meta out
content: Mark Zuckerberg's impressive superyacht, Launchpad, has recently anchored in Japan, right beside Yusaku Maezawa's Nausicaä. Their close proximity underscores an ongoing legal dispute as Maezawa pursues Meta for the misuse of his name in deceptive investment advertising. Even without plans to meet, their vessels symbolize the intense rivalry. After a summer in Alaska, Launchpad is set to chart its course towards Singapore, making this encounter noteworthy.

title: Nebraska couple lost $59,759 home over $588 tax debt; compensation claim revived
content: A Nebraska couple, Kevin Fair and Terry Fair, lost their home due to unpaid property taxes totaling $588. After being unable to pay the amount required to redeem their property, Continental Resources obtained a tax deed. Fair claimed that losing property worth $59,759 for such a small tax debt constituted an unconstitutional taking. The Nebraska Supreme Court ruled Fair had a valid takings claim based on property value.

title: Tom Brady vs Patrick Mahomes: Why TB12 Foundation can't match 15 and Mahomies
content: Tom Brady’s TB12 Foundation was focused on health and wellness of underserved athletes and service members. Patrick Mahomes’ 15 and the Mahomies is focused on children, communities in need of resources and other charitable causes. Mahomes’ foundation is more popular than Brady’s because he has a broader scope with youth initiatives.

title: How Jiner turned struggles in India into taking China closer to Olympiad gold

World No. 4 Zhu Jiner has emerged as the team’s unbeaten Board 1, rebounding strongly from a difficult GCL campaign in Bengaluru. In an exclusive interaction with TimesofIndia.com, she reflects on India’s chess passion, her journey into professional chess, and China’s unexpected title challenge.

title: Quote of the day by Sylvester Stallone
content: Sylvester Stallone shares his reflections on the dual nature of success and failure, emphasizing the importance of choosing one's battles wisely. He advocates for focusing on what is genuinely important, drawing from his own challenging journey in Hollywood, especially before achieving fame with 'Rocky.' The iconic character, Rocky Balboa, epitomizes resilience and the idea of personal development through adversity, a message that resonates in today's competitive environment.

title: 12-year dream powers on: Goulburn's $3.3M community solar farm opens
content: Residents of Goulburn embarked on an inspiring decade-long endeavor to establish a community-driven solar farm alongside a battery system. With the backing of about 300 local investors, they overcame significant obstacles such as regulatory hurdles and supply chain challenges. Ultimately, the solar farm commenced operations, contributing clean energy to the local grid, and stands as an exemplary model for community-led renewable energy initiatives throughout regional Australia.

title: 3 turbines, $35K a year: How wind power cut Iowa farmer's debt by 80%
content: Evie Haupt, an Iowa farmer, has notably increased her revenue by leasing land for wind turbines. This extra income has been instrumental in alleviating her farm debts following her husband's passing. Even though the turbines occupy less than an acre, she continues her traditional farming practices on the bulk of her land. The rise of wind power is transforming the financial prospects for rural landowners nationwide.

title: Jeff Bezos’ Earth Fund adds $25 million for Pacific ocean conservation
content: The Bezos Earth Fund is allocating more than $25 million for ocean conservation projects in five Pacific nations. This funding will support various efforts: enhancing ocean management, establishing marine protected areas, and improving monitoring. The initiative aims to protect a significant portion of the ocean while promoting local leadership and community involvement. Additionally, international waters will also benefit from proposed marine protected areas.

title: Harassed, complained, forced to quit: Employee's viral post

Despite reporting the incidents to HR, her cries for help were dismissed, leading to even more obstacles, including pressure toward her coworkers to file complaints against her. Ultimately, she felt compelled to leave, convinced that the situation would remain unchanged.

title: Daughter reveals mom pawned her gold bangles to pay her NIT admission fee

To ensure Anusmita could attend NIT Trichy, her mother pawned her cherished gold bangles, funding her college fees. This critical support has paved the way for Anusmita’s thriving career at Flipkart. She is now dedicated to honoring her mother's commitment through her efforts, illustrating the vital role of parental encouragement in shaping futures.

title: Alonzo Mourning’s $37.4M housing project offers seniors apartments from $322

title: India is kicking car safety into top gear with Bharat NCAP 2.0: What you need to know

This revised framework will assess vehicle safety across multiple stages, including crash avoidance and post-collision care. The new system promises to go beyond just occupant protection to include vulnerable road users as well. Adult and child occupant protection will remain critical components of the evaluation process.

title: Trump-Xi bonhomie set to continue, leaders announce two more meetings

title: San Antonio oyster shells recycled to rebuild Gulf reefs and marine habitat

The South Texas Coastal Initiative sends collected shells to the Sink Your Shucks program, where they are reused for reef restoration. title: PSU banks lift ATM charges in view of strike

NEW DELHI: Public sector banks and regional rural banks have announced their decision to waive ATM charges to ensure hassle-free cash withdrawal by their customers from Sept 28-30 due to the strike called by employee unions. Besides, all branches of state-run banks and RRB will remain open on Sunday as the unions have called a three-day strike starting Monday. Govt earlier asked for payment of salaries and pension to retired personnel ahead of time to avoid the impact of strike. TNN

title: Months after OSM row, government appoints new CBSE chairperson

Senior bureaucrat Mandeep K Bhandari

title: Amazon, Flipkart & JioMart fined for illegal herbicide sale
content:
Representative image

NEW DELHI: Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) has imposed penalties of Rs 10 lakh each on Amazon and Flipkart, and Rs 5 lakh on JioMart, for selling and advertising an unregistered agrochemical product. Cyclosinone Herbicide is marketed for preventing and eliminating weeds. CCPA directed the e-commerce marketplaces to discontinue false advertisements and conduct self-audits to identify products that violate the law or pose a risk to life and safety. Proceedings began after the department of agriculture and farmers' welfare forwarded a complaint from Crop Care Federation of India. The department said insecticides and pesticides are regulated under Insecticides Act, 1968, and Insecticides Rules. It said no chemical named Cyclosinone was listed in the Act's Schedule, and the product did not disclose its composition. CCPA rejected the companies' argument that they could not be held responsible for products listed by third-party sellers.

End of Article

title: Trump embraces Xi as peer, alarms partners and critics
content: a 48-hour state visit to the united states by Xi Jinping yielded no immediate major breakthroughs . the most consequential message of the visit may have been the choreography itself . a fawning Trump repeatedly described the visit as a friend .

title: US Supreme Court rejects Trump-backed Missouri congressional map for third time
content: the justices halted a ruling by a federal appeals court that would have revived the Republican-friendly map for the midterm elections . the state court had ruled earlier this month that a citizen petition prevents the new congressional map from being used .

title: 2022 Rajouri IED blast: Police file chargesheet against 4
content: two migrant labourers were injured in the explosion below Jaganaloo bridge in Rajouri district on April 19 that year . three of the accused are already behind bars . their handler, Mohammed Qasim alias Salman, conspired the attack and remained in direct contact with Talib Hussain Shah .

title: 'A terrorist country is asking me': Jaishankar's sharp reply to Pak journalist
content: "a terrorist country is asking me that question. Come on," jaishankar said in response to the journalist's question . the journalist stood up and asked, "when will your government stop sponsoring terrorism in Pakistan?" the exchange came a day after an Indian journalist had put Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on the spot as he entered the building .

title: Trump gets Supreme Court nod for voter citizenship checks weeks before midterms
content: mass purges still barred The US Supreme Court allowed the Trump administration to use a controversial federal database to help states check the citizenship status of registered voters . critics have questioned the reliability of the data, warning that the system could result in US citizens being wrongly flagged or removed from voter rolls . the ruling came after a federal judge in June found the expanded use of the system illegal and said it violated american privacy rights .

title: Autonomy reference in Omar’s statehood resolution sparks row; BJP tears up copies
content: Omar Abdullah brought an assembly resolution seeking restoration of statehood . the contentious reference came as the document cited an autonomy resolution passed by the assembly in June 2000 when J&K was a state . Omar has called on the centre to restore statehood for nearly two years .

title: Watch: Russian drones hit McDonald’s-linked warehouse in Ukraine, 5 killed
content: McDonald’s-linked warehouse hit in Kyiv drone attack . McDonald's-link warehouse hit on inkyiv . Ukrainian authorities say five people were killed and 27 injured across the capital . the warehouse was reportedly attacked twice by the Russians .

title: Trump, Xi end 3-day summit with tea, stability pledge & little progress on key disputes
content: Xi and Donald Trump wrapped up their three-day summit on friday with tea at the white house and a tour of the National Archives . he said the talks had produced "tremendous strides" and suggested US farmers would benefit from agreements reached with Beijing .

title: 14 killed in Congo plane crash, two senior military officials among dead
content: the plane crashed while returning to the capital Kinshasa from the southwestern city of Kikwit . the aircraft was carrying a delegation that included the two senior officers . it reportedly developed a technical problem and crashed in Kenge, where all those on board were killed .

title: Trump rejects Iran's 7-day ceasefire offer, expects to resume bombing post midterms
content: president Donald Trump rejects a seven-day ceasefire proposal . he told aides that he expects US bombing of Iran to resume after the midterm elections . the u.s. would lift its naval blockade of Iranian ports, ease sanctions on Iranian oil exports and observe a ceasefire .

title: Marking 'VIPs' routine, was part of SSR even before SIR: Officials
content: EC sources say the instruction to field officers on "flagging of marked electors" was a standard instruction . the instruction was part of all three special intensive revision orders approved by the commission . EC source says the instruction is now being questioned over a software update .
